why: The published control floor 0.903758 (runs/heldout_v2/floor_control.json, ckpt "e1_untrained.hf") was measured on this directory, which exists ONLY on the pod /tmp and has no counterpart in git. config.json carries NO _name_or_path or revision, so the weight hash below is the ONLY identity it has: a re-download from HF can be CHECKED against this, but nothing here proves which HF checkpoint or revision it came from. Untrained/random-init is asserted by the fact name, not by anything in the directory.
